tasks.title: CaptureRig.LastReport() can return a stale shot's measurement after a skipped shot
tasks.why: Read in code. The diff's two new catches both leave LastJson/Last (CaptureRig.cs:74) untouched on failure: TryPose (CaptureRig.cs:122-130) catches Pose and the loop does `if (!TryPose(...)) continue;`, and Render's own try/catch (CaptureRig.cs:188-210) returns before reaching the `LastJson = Measure(...)` / `Last = shot.Path` lines at 195-198. Either failure is only logged with Debug.LogError; TacticalCamera's static LastReport() (CaptureRig.cs:590, documented at workflow.md:460 as 'the measurements from the last still, so a script can read them without opening the file') keeps returning whatever the previous successful shot wrote, with nothing in the API saying which shot it belongs to. A caller that queues a multi-shot Series and reads LastReport() after a shot that threw gets the wrong still's numbers attributed to the shot it actually asked about.
tasks.done_when: LastJson/Last are cleared (or tagged with the failed shot's path) when TryPose returns false or Render's catch fires, so a script reading LastReport() after a skipped shot sees that no measurement exists for that shot rather than the previous one's; a test queues two shots where the first throws in Pose and asserts LastReport() does not silently report the second shot's numbers as the first's.
